

# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS



#### Linear Mixed Modelling

##### Nutritional status

```{r nutritional_status_adm, fig.width=6, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)

load("../Networks/maln_TimePoint_ntwk_24Percent.Rdata")

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigeMeta_adm.csv")


# "../Data/Processed/FinalOutputFiles/SampleTable_all_syndromes_meta.csv"

SampleTable_all_syndromes_meta <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/FinalOutputFiles/SampleTable_all_syndromes_meta.csv")

ncc_24Percent_metadata <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/chain_hospitalised_adm_ncc_24Percent_1008.csv")


SampleTable_all_syndromes_meta <- SampleTable_all_syndromes_meta %>% 
  dplyr::filter(record_id %in% ncc_24Percent_metadata$record_id)

#SampleTable_all_syndromes_meta$record_id <- as.character(SampleTable_all_syndromes_meta$record_id)
######################################################
# Extract the modules
######################################################

admission_network <- maln_TimePoint_ntwk_24Percent$A0 # maln_TimePoint_ntwk

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- admission_network@moduleEigengenes

colnames(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen) <- colnames(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen) %>%
  str_remove("^C") %>%    # Remove the leading 'C'
  str_remove("_A0$")      # Remove the trailing '_A0'

rownames(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen) <- gsub("^A0_(\\d{3})$", "PM\\1_adm", rownames(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen))


MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "record_id")


# write_csv(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen, "../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen_adm.csv")


# write_csv(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen, "../Data/Processed/multiWGCNA/AdmissionPoint/MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen_adm.csv")


######################################################
# Combine the meta data and module information
######################################################


MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen_adm.csv")


# MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/multiWGCNA/AdmissionPoint/MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen_adm.csv")

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., SampleTable_all_syndromes_meta, join_by(record_id)) %>% 
  dplyr::relocate(age_adm:pneumonia, .after = record_id) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-PM000_adm) # remove PM000_adm that contains unassigned proteins. Not useful downstream analysis.  


MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(weights = case_when(status_disch_recoded %in% "Yes" & wasting  == "NW" ~ 1.00,
                                    status_disch_recoded %in% "Yes" & wasting  == "MW" ~ 0.40,
                                    status_disch_recoded %in% "Yes" & wasting  == "SW" ~ 0.39,
                                    status_disch_recoded %in% "No" & wasting  == "NW" ~ 4.17,
                                    status_disch_recoded %in% "No" & wasting  == "MW" ~ 1.67,
                                    status_disch_recoded %in% "No" & wasting  == "SW" ~ 1.63)
                ) %>% 
  dplyr::relocate(weights, .after = pneumonia)



MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$wasting <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$wasting,
                                                          levels = c("NW", "MW", "SW"))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria, 
                                             levels = c("malNegative", "malPositive"))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$diarrhoea <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$diarrhoea, 
                                               levels = c("diarrhoeaNo", "diarrhoeaYes"))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$TB <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$TB,levels = c("tbNegative", "tbPositive"))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$HIV <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$HIV,
                                                          levels = c("HUU", "HEU", "HEI"))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$measles <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$measles,
                                             levels = c("measlesNegative", "measlesPositive"))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$sepsis <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$sepsis,
                                                     levels = c("sepsisNo", "sepsisYes"))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$SIRS <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$SIRS, 
                                            levels = c("sirsNo", "sirsYes"))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$anemia <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$anemia,
                                                          levels = c("anemiaNone", "anemiaMild", 
                                                                     "anemiaModerate", "anemiaSevere"))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$pneumonia <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$pneumonia,
                                                          levels = c("pneumoniaNo", "pneumoniaYes"))


# write_csv(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen, "../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigeMeta_adm.csv")



# write_csv(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen, "../Data/Processed/multiWGCNA/AdmissionPoint/MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigeMeta_adm.csv")

######################################################
# Linear mixed modelling
######################################################

ModuleEigen_df <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(PM001_adm:PM045_adm)

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ wasting  +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".wastingMW|.wastingSW",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Wasting"))

Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting <- gsub("wasting", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "bonferroni") # fdr

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules, Wasting) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Create a new column 'significance' based on the conditions
Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(significance_both = ifelse(sum(Wasting == "SW" & significance == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &
                                    sum(Wasting == "MW" & significance == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                    "Common", "Not Common")) %>%
  ungroup()



Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(color_both = ifelse(sum(Wasting == "SW" & significance == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &
                                    sum(Wasting == "MW" & significance == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                    "darkgreen", "grey30")) %>%
  ungroup()

######################################################
# Module size
######################################################

admission_networkModuleProteins <- admission_network@datExpr

colnames(admission_networkModuleProteins) <- colnames(admission_networkModuleProteins) %>%
  str_remove("^C") %>%    # Remove the leading 'C'
  str_remove("_A0$") 

admission_networkModuleProteins <- as.data.frame(admission_networkModuleProteins)

admission_networkModuleProteins <- admission_networkModuleProteins %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Aptmers") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-X)


adm_ntwk_moduleSize <- admission_networkModuleProteins %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(dynamicLabels) %>% 
  summarise(size = n())

adm_ntwk_moduleSize$dynamicLabels <- gsub("^A0_(\\d{3})$", "PM\\1_adm", adm_ntwk_moduleSize$dynamicLabels)

adm_ntwk_moduleSize <- adm_ntwk_moduleSize[-1,]


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., adm_ntwk_moduleSize, join_by(Modules == dynamicLabels) )

######################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
######################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Wasting, Estimate)


Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_nutri_status <- Coefficient_etimate_clean


# write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_nutri_status, "../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_nutri_status_adm.csv")


# write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_nutri_status, "../Data/Processed/multiWGCNA/AdmissionPoint/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_nutri_status_adm.csv")

######################################################



# Coefficient_etimate_clean <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/multiWGCNA/AdmissionPoint/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_nutri_status_adm.csv")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_nutri_status_adm.csv")

Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules <- gsub("_adm$", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules)

cPM_wasting_no_muac_adjustment <- 
  Coefficient_etimate_clean  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = fct_reorder(Modules, Estimate), col = significance)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Estimate), size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                 height = 0.45, linewidth = 0.75) +
  #scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-60, 20, by = 10)) +
  #geom_linerange(aes(xmin=Lower_bound_C1_2, xmax=Upper_bound_C1_2))   +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed",  linewidth = 0.35 ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  xlim(-0.04, 0.04) +
  theme_light()+
  labs(x="Coefficient estimates (95% CI)", y="Modules", title = "Nutritional status",
       color = "BP Signf status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.53),
        legend.position = c(0.95, 0.905),
        text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        legend.title  =  element_text(size=5),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05,"cm"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        # Change Y-axis label colors based on 'significance_both'
        # axis.text.y = element_markdown(face = "bold" # ,color = Coefficient_etimate_clean$color_both
        #                                ),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "grey95")
        ) +
  #ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  # facet_wrap(~ Nutri_status, scales = "free_y")
  facet_grid(~ Wasting) +
  guides(y.sec=ggh4x::guide_axis_manual(title = element_blank(),
                                        breaks = Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules,
                                        labels = paste0("n=", Coefficient_etimate_clean$size)))
```

### SHINY APP

```{r}

proteom_shinyapp <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen

proteom_shinyapp <- proteom_shinyapp %>% dplyr::select(record_id, starts_with("PM")) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "record_id")

colnames(proteom_shinyapp) <- colnames(proteom_shinyapp)  %>%
  sub("_adm$", "", .) %>%           # Remove '_adm'
  sub("^PM", "", .)                 # Remove 'PM'
  
colnames(proteom_shinyapp) <- ifelse(
  colnames(proteom_shinyapp)== "000", 
  "00", 
  sub("^0+", "", colnames(proteom_shinyapp))  # Remove leading zeros
)

colnames(proteom_shinyapp) <- sprintf("PM%02d", as.integer(colnames(proteom_shinyapp)))

colnames(proteom_shinyapp) <- gsub("_adm$", "", colnames(proteom_shinyapp)) 


proteom_shinyapp <- proteom_shinyapp %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "record_id")

proteom_shinyapp_meta <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(record_id, !contains("PM"))


proteom_shinyapp_meta$record_id <- as.character(proteom_shinyapp_meta$record_id)

proteom_shinyapp_meta1 <- proteom_shinyapp_meta %>% dplyr::select(1:9)

proteom_shinyapp <- proteom_shinyapp %>% dplyr::left_join(proteom_shinyapp_meta1, join_by(record_id))


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)


proteom_shinyapp_recode <- proteom_shinyapp_meta %>% dplyr::select(10:19)

# Example: assume your dataframe is called `df`
df_recode <- proteom_shinyapp_recode %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ case_when(
    str_detect(., "Yes$|Positive$") ~ "Positive",
    str_detect(., "No$|Negative$") ~ "Negative",
    TRUE ~ .
  )))


df_recode <- df_recode %>% dplyr::mutate(anemia = dplyr::recode(anemia, 
                                                   "anemiaNone" = "None",
                                                   "anemiaMild" = "Mild",
                                                   "anemiaModerate" = "Moderate", 
                                                   "anemiaSevere" = "Severe"))

names(df_recode) <- stringr::str_replace(names(df_recode), "^(.)", toupper)


proteom_shinyapp <- bind_cols(proteom_shinyapp, df_recode)


names(proteom_shinyapp) <- stringr::str_replace(names(proteom_shinyapp), "^(.)", toupper)

proteom_shinyapp <- proteom_shinyapp %>% dplyr::rename(record_id = Record_id)

colnames(proteom_shinyapp) <- gsub("_adm$", "", colnames(proteom_shinyapp))


saveRDS(proteom_shinyapp, file = "../Manuscript/shinyApp/Data/protein_modules.rds")

saveRDS(soma_proteome_wideFormat_human_adm_exp, file = "../Manuscript/shinyApp/Data/soma_proteome_wideFormat_human_adm_exp.rds")

##################################################################################################

proteins1 <- soma_proteome_wideFormat_human_adm_exp

proteins1 <- proteins1 %>%
  dplyr::select(aptamers_uniprotid$AptName)

colnames(proteins1) <- aptamers_uniprotid$UniProt

proteins1.1 <- proteins1

colnames(proteins1.1) <- sub(".*\\|", "", colnames(proteins1.1))

duplicated_proteins <- duplicated(colnames(proteins1.1))

colnames(proteins1.1)[duplicated_proteins] <- aptamers_uniprotid$AptName[duplicated_proteins]

ProteomeRawExp <- proteins1.1 %>% rownames_to_column(var = "record_id")

ProteomeRawExp <- ProteomeRawExp %>% dplyr::filter(record_id %in% proteom_shinyapp$record_id)


saveRDS(ProteomeRawExp, file = "../Manuscript/shinyApp/Data/ProteomeRawExp.rds")


######################################################################################################

ProteomeRawExpCommunity <- soma_proteome_longFormat_human %>% 
  dplyr::filter(TimePoint %in% "CP")


## select for columns with record Ids and protein intensity only for downstream analysis in WGCNA

ProteomeRawExpCommunity <- ProteomeRawExpCommunity %>% 
  dplyr::select(record_id, AptName, Intensity) # %>% dplyr::filter(record_id != "0001016 A") # remove the participant with incorrect record ID
 

ProteomeRawExpCommunityExp <-   ProteomeRawExpCommunity %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(record_id, AptName) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(Intensity = sum(Intensity)) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = AptName, values_from =  Intensity, 
                     values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "record_id") %>%  # convert the record id to row names for log10 transfromation and autoscaling
  ungroup()


######################################################################################################

proteins1 <- ProteomeRawExpCommunityExp

proteins1 <- proteins1 %>%
  dplyr::select(aptamers_uniprotid$AptName)

colnames(proteins1) <- aptamers_uniprotid$UniProt

proteins1.1 <- proteins1

colnames(proteins1.1) <- sub(".*\\|", "", colnames(proteins1.1))

duplicated_proteins <- duplicated(colnames(proteins1.1))

colnames(proteins1.1)[duplicated_proteins] <- aptamers_uniprotid$AptName[duplicated_proteins]

ProteomeRawExpCommunityExp <- proteins1.1 %>% rownames_to_column(var = "record_id")

saveRDS(ProteomeRawExpCommunityExp, file = "../Manuscript/shinyApp/Data/ProteomeRawExpCommunityExp.rds")
```

```{r muac_adm_wasting_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.8, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}


adm_ntwk_moduleSize <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/adm_ntwk_moduleSize.csv")

ModuleEigen_df <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/ModuleEigen_df_adm.csv")

library(ggtext)

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ muac_adm  +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".muac_adm",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "MUAC_adm"))

           ) %>%

  ) %>%

# Create a new column 'significance' based on the conditions
```

```{r malaria_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.8, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
                                               levels = c("diarrhoeaNo", "diarrhoeaYes"))

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ malaria  + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

  group_by(Modules # Wasting,

    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Create a new column 'significance' based on the conditions

                                                 "Yes", "No")
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv(
  "../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria.csv"
)


original_results <- original_results %>% mutate(
      Modules = sprintf(
          "PM%02d",
          as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
      ))
  

# original_results$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(original_results$`Pr(>|t|)`,
#                                                        method = "fdr")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <- MalariaSensitivityAnaemiaDiarrhoea

# Harmonise module names before merging
original_results <- original_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

adjusted_results <- adjusted_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_malaria <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_malaria$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_malaria$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_malaria_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_malaria,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Original only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Malaria",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_malaria_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/MalariaSensitivityAnaemiaDiarrhoea_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_malaria, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/corr_df_malaria.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r run_next-chunk}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::recode)

# Starting from corr_df_malaria
concordance_df <- corr_df_malaria %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,

    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant,

    Concordance_status = case_when(
      Original_significant & Sensitivity_significant ~ "Significant in both",
      !Original_significant & !Sensitivity_significant ~ "Non-significant in both",
      Original_significant & !Sensitivity_significant ~ "Original only",
      !Original_significant & Sensitivity_significant ~ "Sensitivity only"
    ),

    Concordance_symbol = if_else(Concordant, "\u2713", "\u00d7")
  )


############################################################################################

model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Significant"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Original",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Symbol = if_else(Significant, "\u2713", "\u2013")
  )


##########################################################################################

concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Significant = Concordant,
    Symbol = Concordance_symbol
  )

##########################################################################################
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Original",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    )
  )


##########################################################################################


concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = Significant),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Symbol),
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "TRUE" = "grey70",
      "FALSE" = "white"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "TRUE" = "Yes",
      "FALSE" = "No"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Protein module",
    title = "Malaria sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    fill = "Significant or\nconcordant"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/concordance_plot.pdf", 
       height = 15, width  = 10)
```

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_malaria %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",

        "Discordant"

  )
```

```{r diarrhoea_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)


ModuleEigen_df <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/ModuleEigen_df_adm.csv")

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$diarrhoea <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$diarrhoea, 
                                               levels = c("diarrhoeaNo", "diarrhoeaYes"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ diarrhoea  + malaria + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Diarrhoea"))

                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules # Wasting, 
           ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_diarrhoea.csv")

original_results <- original_results %>% mutate(
      Modules = sprintf(
          "PM%02d",
          as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
      ))

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <- DiarrhoeaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea

# Harmonise module names before merging
original_results <- original_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

adjusted_results <- adjusted_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_Diarrhoea <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_Diarrhoea$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_Diarrhoea$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_Diarrhoea_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_Diarrhoea,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Diarrhoea",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_Diarrhoea_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/DiarrhoeaSensitivityAnaemiaDiarrhoea_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_Diarrhoea, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/corr_df_Diarrhoea.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_Diarrhoea %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )



# plot_df$Modules <- ifelse(
#   plot_df$dynamicLabels == "000", 
#   "00", 
#   sub("^0+", "", plot_df$Modules)  # Remove leading zeros
# )

# plot_df$Modules <- sprintf("PM%02d", as.integer(plot_df$Modules))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = sprintf(
      "PM%02d",
      as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
    )
  )



##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Protein module",
    title = "Diarrhoea sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

```{r tb_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$TB <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$TB,levels = c("tbNegative", "tbPositive"))

  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ TB  + malaria + diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

  group_by(Modules # Wasting,
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_TB.csv")

original_results <- original_results %>% mutate(
      Modules = sprintf(
          "PM%02d",
          as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
      ))

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  TBSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia

# Harmonise module names before merging
original_results <- original_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

adjusted_results <- adjusted_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_TB <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_TB$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_TB$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_TB_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_TB,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "TB",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_TB_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/TBSensitivityAnaemiaTB_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_TB, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/corr_df_TB.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_TB %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )



# plot_df$Modules <- ifelse(
#   plot_df$dynamicLabels == "000", 
#   "00", 
#   sub("^0+", "", plot_df$Modules)  # Remove leading zeros
# )

# plot_df$Modules <- sprintf("PM%02d", as.integer(plot_df$Modules))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = sprintf(
      "PM%02d",
      as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
    )
  )



##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Protein module",
    title = "TB sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot
```

```{r hiv_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=6, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)
MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$HIV <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$HIV,
                                                          levels = c("HUU", "HEU", "HEI"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ HIV  + malaria + diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".HIVHEU|.HIVHEI",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "HIV"))

Coefficient_etimate_clean$HIV <- gsub("HIV", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$HIV)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr")  # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules, HIV) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
                                                   "Yes", "No")

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(significance_both = ifelse(sum(HIV == "HEU" & significance == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &
                                    sum(HIV == "HEU" & significance == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                    "Common", "Not Common")) %>%
  ungroup()



Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(color_both = ifelse(sum(HIV == "HEU" & significance == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &
                                    sum(HIV == "HEI" & significance == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                    "darkgreen", "grey30")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_HIV.csv")

original_results <- original_results %>% dplyr::filter(HIV == "HEI") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(HIV =  dplyr::recode(HIV, "HEI" = "HIV+"))

original_results <- original_results %>% mutate(
      Modules = sprintf(
          "PM%02d",
          as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
      ))


HIVSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia <- HIVSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia %>%
  dplyr::filter(HIV == "HIV+")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  HIVSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia

# Harmonise module names before merging
original_results <- original_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

adjusted_results <- adjusted_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_HIV <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_HIV$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_HIV$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_HIV_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_HIV,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "HIV",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.22, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_HIV_plot

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_HIV, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/corr_df_HIV.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_HIV %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = sprintf(
      "PM%02d",
      as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
    )
  )



##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Protein module",
    title = "HIV sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/concordance_HIV_plot.pdf",
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_sepsis.csv")

original_results <- original_results %>% mutate(
      Modules = sprintf(
          "PM%02d",
          as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
      ))

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  SepsisSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia

# Harmonise module names before merging
original_results <- original_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

adjusted_results <- adjusted_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_Sepsis <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_Sepsis$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_Sepsis$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_Sepsis_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_Sepsis,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Original model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Sepsis",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_Sepsis_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/SepsisSensitivityAnaemiaSepsis_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_Sepsis, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/corr_df_Sepsis.xlsx")


```


###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_Sepsis %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = sprintf(
      "PM%02d",
      as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
    )
  )



##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Protein module",
    title = "Sepsis sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/concordance_Sepsis_plot.pdf", 
       height = 9, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r}
        "Sensitivity only",

      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(

)

    linewidth = 0.8

    size = 3.5,

    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,

    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_SIRS %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = sprintf(
      "PM%02d",
      as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
    )
  )



##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Protein module",
    title = "SIRS sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

```{r anemia_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=8, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$anemia <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$anemia,
                                                          levels = c("anemiaNone", "anemiaMild", 
                                                                     "anemiaModerate", "anemiaSevere"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ anemia  + malaria + diarrhoea +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

                                                       method = "bonferroni") # bonferroni fdr

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules, Anaemia) %>%

  ) %>%

                                      sum(Anaemia == "anemiaSevere" & significance == "Yes",

                                    "darkgreen", "grey30")) %>%
```

######## Mild Anaemia

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_anaemia.csv")

original_results <- original_results %>% dplyr::filter(Anaemia == "Mild")

original_results <- original_results %>% mutate(
      Modules = sprintf(
          "PM%02d",
          as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
      ))


MildAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea <- AnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea %>%
  dplyr::filter(Anaemia == "Mild")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  MildAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea

# Harmonise module names before merging
original_results <- original_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

adjusted_results <- adjusted_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_MildAnaemia_df <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_MildAnaemia_df$Estimate_original,
  corr_MildAnaemia_df$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_MildAnaemia_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_MildAnaemia_df,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Mild Anaemia",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.22, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

```{r}
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
```

######## Severe Anaemia

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_anaemia.csv")

original_results <- original_results %>% dplyr::filter(Anaemia == "Severe")

original_results <- original_results %>% mutate(
      Modules = sprintf(
          "PM%02d",
          as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
      ))


SevereAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea <- AnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea %>%
  dplyr::filter(Anaemia == "Severe")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  SevereAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea

# Harmonise module names before merging
original_results <- original_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

adjusted_results <- adjusted_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_SevereAnaemia_df <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_SevereAnaemia_df$Estimate_original,
  corr_SevereAnaemia_df$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_SevereAnaemia_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_SevereAnaemia_df,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Severe Anaemia",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.22, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

######## Mild Anaemia

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_MildAnaemia_df %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = sprintf(
      "PM%02d",
      as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
    )
  )



##########################################################################################

MildAnaemiaConcordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Protein module",
    title = "Mild Anaemia sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
