##### Pneumonia + Malaria + Diarrhoea + Anaemia 

```{r pneumonia_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.6, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$pneumonia <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$pneumonia,
                                                          levels = c("pneumoniaNo", "pneumoniaYes"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ pneumonia  + malaria + diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".pneumoniapneumoniaYes",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Pneumonia"))


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_pneumonia.csv")


original_results <- original_results %>% mutate(
      Modules = sprintf(
          "PM%02d",
          as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
      ))

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  PneumoniaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia

# Harmonise module names before merging
original_results <- original_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

adjusted_results <- adjusted_results %>%
  mutate(Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules))

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_pneumonia <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_pneumonia$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_pneumonia$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_pneumonia_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_pneumonia,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Pneumonia",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_pneumonia_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/pneumoniaSensitivityAnaemiapneumonia_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_pneumonia, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/corr_df_pneumonia.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_pneumonia %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = sprintf(
      "PM%02d",
      as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
    )
  )



##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Protein module",
    title = "Pneumonia sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/concordance_pneumonia_plot.pdf", height = 9, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r}
      TRUE ~ "None"

ModuleEigen_df <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("PM"))

Adjustedmod_summaries_interaction <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries_interaction[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ malaria*AnaemiaSeverity + # diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries_interaction[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
                                                   "Yes", "No")

# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
```

```{r}
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries_additive[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% dplyr::filter(str_detect(Modules, "\\.malariamalPositive$"))

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Malaria"))


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
                                                   "Yes", "No")
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    module_number = as.integer(str_extract(Modules, "\\d+")),

    # PM26 becomes PM026_adm
    module_column = sprintf("PM%03d_adm", module_number),

    # Preserve the order in your results table
    Modules = factor(Modules, levels = Modules)
  )


format_fdr <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("NA")
  }

  if (p < 0.001) {
    return(formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
  }

  formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
}


make_module_plot <- function(module_name,
                             module_column,
                             adjusted_p,
                             data) {

  # Extract data for the current module
  module_data <- data %>%
    transmute(
      malaria_recoded,
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      module_value = .data[[module_column]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(module_value),
      !is.na(malaria_recoded),
      !is.na(AnaemiaSeverity)
    )

  # Participant numbers for each malaria–anaemia group
  count_data <- module_data %>%
    count(
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      malaria_recoded,
      name = "n"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      malaria_recoded,
      fill = list(n = 0)
    )

  # Calculate positions for participant-count labels
  y_min <- min(module_data$module_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(module_data$module_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

  if (!is.finite(y_range) || y_range == 0) {
    y_range <- 1
  }

  count_data <- count_data %>%
    mutate(
      y_position = y_min - 0.10 * y_range,
      n_label = paste0("n=", n)
    )

  ggplot(
    module_data,
    aes(
      x = malaria_recoded,
      y = module_value,
      fill = AnaemiaSeverity
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.65,
      linewidth = 0.35,
      outlier.size = 0.8,
      outlier.alpha = 0.65,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = count_data,
      aes(
        x = malaria_recoded,
        y = y_position,
        label = n_label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.8,
      vjust = 1
    ) +

    facet_grid(
      cols = vars(AnaemiaSeverity),
      scales = "fixed",
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "None" = "lightgreen",
        "Mild" = "lightyellow",
        "Moderate" = "pink",
        "Severe" = "red4"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.22, 0.08))
    ) +

    labs(
      title = module_name,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Interaction FDR = ",
        format_fdr(adjusted_p)
      ),
      x = "Malaria",
      y = module_name,
      fill = NULL
    ) +

    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 12,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 2)
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "plain",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 5)
      ),

      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 8)
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "plain"
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 8,
        face = "plain"
      ),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.075, "cm"),

      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "plain",
        colour = "black"
      ),

      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey85",
        colour = "grey40",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.25,
        colour = "grey92"
      ),

      panel.spacing.x = unit(0.08, "cm"),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 5,
        r = 5,
        b = 5,
        l = 5
      )
    )
}


module_plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(plot_modules)), function(i){

})
```

```{r warning=FALSE, syndrome_associations_5, fig.height=9, fig.width=7.8}
                                           dec_inc_anaemia_moderate, dec_inc_anaemia_severe,

  dplyr::rename(Modules = Modules...1) %>%

  dplyr::select(!starts_with("Modules..."))
```

# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS METABOLOMICS

#### Linear Mixed Modelling

##### Nutritional status

```{r nutritional_status_adm, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)

admission_ntwk_moduleSize <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/admission_ntwk_moduleSize3.csv")

MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Metabolite_modules_metadata.csv")

# MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/multiWGCNA/Metabolite_modules_metadata.csv")


# Define a named list of column names and their levels
factor_levels <- list(
  wasting = c("NW", "MW", "SW"),
  malaria = c("malNegative", "malPositive"),
  diarrhoea = c("diarrhoeaNo", "diarrhoeaYes"),
  TB = c("tbNegative", "tbPositive"),
  HIV = c("HUU", "HEU", "HIV+"),
  measles = c("measlesNegative", "measlesPositive"),
  sepsis = c("sepsisNo", "sepsisYes"),
  SIRS = c("sirsNo", "sirsYes"),
  anemia = c("anemiaNone", "anemiaMild", "anemiaModerate", "anemiaSevere"),
  pneumonia = c("pneumoniaNo", "pneumoniaYes")
)

# Apply factor conversion to each column
MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen <- MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(names(factor_levels), ~factor(.x, levels = factor_levels[[cur_column()]])))


######################################################
# Linear mixed modelling
######################################################

MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen <- MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(-MM00)

ModuleEigen_df <- MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("MM"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ wasting  +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".wastingMW|.wastingSW",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Wasting"))

Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting <- gsub("wasting", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules, Wasting) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Create a new column 'significance' based on the conditions
Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")

######################################################
# Module size
######################################################


modules_size <- admission_ntwk_moduleSize

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., modules_size, join_by(Modules) )

######################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
######################################################

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Wasting, Estimate)


Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_nutri_status <- Coefficient_etimate_clean


write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_nutri_status, "../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_nutri_status.csv")


# write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_nutri_status, "../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/multiWGCNA/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_nutri_status.csv")


######################################################
# Forest plot with estimates
######################################################


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_nutri_status.csv")


# Coefficient_etimate_clean <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/multiWGCNA/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_nutri_status.csv")


wasting_no_muac_adjustment <- 
  Coefficient_etimate_clean  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = fct_reorder(Modules, Estimate), col = significance)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Estimate), size = 1.25) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                 height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.55) +
  #scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-60, 20, by = 10)) +
  #geom_linerange(aes(xmin=Lower_bound_C1_2, xmax=Upper_bound_C1_2))   +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed",  linewidth = 0.35 ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  # xlim(-0.08, 0.08) +
  theme_light()+
  labs(x="Coefficient estimates (95% CI)", y="Modules", title = "Nutritional status",
       color = "BP Signf status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.53),
        legend.position = c(0.95, 0.905),
        text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        legend.title  =  element_text(size=5),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05,"cm"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "grey95")
        ) +
  #ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  # facet_wrap(~ Nutri_status, scales = "free_y")
  facet_grid(~ Wasting) +
  guides(y.sec=ggh4x::guide_axis_manual(title = element_blank(),
                                        breaks = Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules,
                                        labels = paste0("n=", Coefficient_etimate_clean$size)))
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <-  read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_malaria.csv")


# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <- MalariaSensitivityMetabolomics

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_Malaria <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_Malaria$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_Malaria$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_Malaria_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_Malaria,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Malaria",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_Malaria_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/MalariaSensitivityAnaemiaMalaria_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_Malaria %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )





##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Metabolite module",
    title = "Malaria sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/concordance_Malaria_plot.pdf", 
       height = 6, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r diarrhoea_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize3, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)

MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen$diarrhoea <- factor(MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen$diarrhoea, 
                                               levels = c("diarrhoeaNo", "diarrhoeaYes"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ diarrhoea  + malaria + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

  group_by(Modules # Wasting, 
           ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
```

```{r tb_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize3, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)

  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ TB  + malaria + diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

                                                       method = "bonferroni") # bonferroni

  group_by(Modules # Wasting, 
           ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_tb.csv")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  TBSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_TB <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_TB$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_TB$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_TB_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_TB,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "TB",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_TB_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/TBSensitivityAnaemiaTB_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_TB, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/corr_df_TB.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_TB %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Metabolite module",
    title = "TB sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/concordance_TB_plot.pdf", 
       height = 6, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_HIV.csv")


original_results <- original_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(HIV == "HIV+")


HIVSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia <- HIVSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia %>%
  dplyr::filter(HIV == "HIV+")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  HIVSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia


# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_HIV <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_HIV$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_HIV$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_HIV_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_HIV,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "HIV",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.22, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_HIV_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/HIVSensitivityAnaemiaHIV_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_HIV, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/corr_df_HIV.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_HIV %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Metabolite module",
    title = "HIV sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/concordance_HIV_plot.pdf", 
       height = 6, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r sepse_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize3, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)

ModuleEigen_df <- MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("MM"))

MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen$sepsis <- factor(MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen$sepsis,
                                                     levels = c("sepsisNo", "sepsisYes"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ sepsis  + malaria + diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl("sepsissepsisYes",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Sepsis"))

# Coefficient_etimate_clean$HIV <- gsub("HIV", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$HIV)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                  "Yes", "No")



############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)


Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_sepsis <- Coefficient_etimate_clean


write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_sepsis, "../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/multiWGCNA/Sensitivity/sepsis_sensitivity.csv")
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_sirs.csv")


# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  SIRSSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_SIRS <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_SIRS$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_SIRS$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_SIRS_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_SIRS,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "SIRS",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.23, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_SIRS_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/SIRSSensitivityAnaemiaSIRS_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_SIRS, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/corr_df_SIRS.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_SIRS %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Metabolite module",
    title = "SIRS sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/concordance_SIRS_plot.pdf", height = 6, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r}
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation

  corr_MildAnaemia_df$Estimate_original,

)

# Plot

    x = Estimate_original,

) +
  geom_point(

    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(

    size = 3.5,
```

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <-  read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_anaemia.csv")

original_results <- original_results %>% dplyr::filter(Anaemia == "Moderate")


ModerateAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea <- AnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea %>%
  dplyr::filter(Anaemia == "Moderate")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  ModerateAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_ModerateAnaemia_df <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_ModerateAnaemia_df$Estimate_original,
  corr_ModerateAnaemia_df$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",

      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),

  ) +
```

##### Concordance plot

######## Mild Anaemia

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_MildAnaemia_df %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

MildAnaemiaConcordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Metabolite module",
    title = "Mild Anaemia sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

MildAnaemiaConcordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/concordance_MildAnaemia_plot.pdf", 
       height = 6, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r fig.width=5.5, fig.height=9}
Anaemia_noMUACAdjustment <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_anaemia.csv")

MildAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea$Model_type <- "Sensitivity model"

mildanaemia_original_sensitvity <- bind_rows(mildanaemia_original, SevereAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea)

# MildAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea ModerateAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea SevereAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea

mildanaemia_original_sensitvity_plot <- mildanaemia_original_sensitvity  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y =  fct_reorder(Modules, Estimate), colour = significance)) + # fct_reorder(Modules, Estimate)

  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                 height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.55) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red3", "No" = "gray70")) +

  theme_light()+

  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.52),
```

```{r pneumonia_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.6, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)

MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen$pneumonia <- factor(MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen$pneumonia,
                                                          levels = c("pneumoniaNo", "pneumoniaYes"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ pneumonia  + muac_adm + malaria + diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".pneumoniapneumoniaYes",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Pneumonia"))


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
                                                   "Yes", "No")


############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)


Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_pneumonia <- Coefficient_etimate_clean
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules3_pneumonia.csv")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  PneumoniaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_pneumonia <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_pneumonia$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_pneumonia$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_pneumonia_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_pneumonia,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Pneumonia",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.21, 0.74),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_pneumonia_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/pneumoniaSensitivityAnaemiapneumonia_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_pneumonia, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/corr_df_pneumonia.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_pneumonia %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )



##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Metabolite module",
    title = "Pneumonia sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/metabolomics/concordance_pneumonia_plot.pdf", height = 6, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
plot_modules <- protein_modules_signif_interaction %>%
  mutate(
    module_number = as.integer(str_extract(Modules, "\\d+")),

    # PM26 becomes PM026_adm
    module_column = sprintf("PM%03d_adm", module_number),

    # Preserve the order in your results table
    Modules = factor(Modules, levels = Modules)
  )


format_fdr <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("NA")
  }

  if (p < 0.001) {
    return(formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
  }

  formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
}


make_module_plot <- function(module_name,
                             module_column,
                             adjusted_p,
                             data) {

  # Extract data for the current module
  module_data <- data %>%
    transmute(
      malaria_recoded,
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      module_value = .data[[module_column]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(module_value),
      !is.na(malaria_recoded),
      !is.na(AnaemiaSeverity)
    )

  # Participant numbers for each malaria–anaemia group
  count_data <- module_data %>%
    count(
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      malaria_recoded,
      name = "n"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      malaria_recoded,
      fill = list(n = 0)
    )

  # Calculate positions for participant-count labels
  y_min <- min(module_data$module_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(module_data$module_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

  if (!is.finite(y_range) || y_range == 0) {
    y_range <- 1
  }

  count_data <- count_data %>%
    mutate(
      y_position = y_min - 0.10 * y_range,
      n_label = paste0("n=", n)
    )

  ggplot(
    module_data,
    aes(
      x = malaria_recoded,
      y = module_value,
      fill = AnaemiaSeverity
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.65,
      linewidth = 0.35,
      outlier.size = 0.8,
      outlier.alpha = 0.65,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = count_data,
      aes(
        x = malaria_recoded,
        y = y_position,
        label = n_label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.8,
      vjust = 1
    ) +

    facet_grid(
      cols = vars(AnaemiaSeverity),
      scales = "fixed",
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "None" = "lightgreen",
        "Mild" = "lightyellow",
        "Moderate" = "pink",
        "Severe" = "red4"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.22, 0.08))
    ) +

    labs(
      title = module_name,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Interaction FDR = ",
        format_fdr(adjusted_p)
      ),
      x = "Malaria",
      y = module_name,
      fill = NULL
    ) +

    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 12,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 2)
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "plain",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 5)
      ),

      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 8)
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "plain"
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 8,
        face = "plain"
      ),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.075, "cm"),

      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "plain",
        colour = "black"
      ),

      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey85",
        colour = "grey40",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.25,
        colour = "grey92"
      ),

      panel.spacing.x = unit(0.08, "cm"),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 5,
        r = 5,
        b = 5,
        l = 5
      )
    )
}


module_plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(plot_modules)), function(i){

  make_module_plot(
    module_name   = plot_modules$Modules[i],
    module_column = plot_modules$module_column[i],

})
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <-  read_csv("../Data/Processed/Lipidomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules5_malaria.csv")



# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <- MalariaSensitivityLipidomics

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_Malaria <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_Malaria$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_Malaria$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_Malaria_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_Malaria,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Malaria",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_Malaria_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/MalariaSensitivityAnaemiaMalaria_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_Malaria, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/corr_df_Malaria.xlsx")
```
