###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_Malaria %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )





##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Lipid module",
    title = "Malaria sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/concordance_Malaria_plot.pdf", 
       height = 7.5, width  = 5.5)
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- Diarrhoea_noMUACAdjustment <-  read_csv("../Data/Processed/Lipidomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules5_diarrhoea.csv")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <- DiarrhoeaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_Diarrhoea <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_Diarrhoea$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_Diarrhoea$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_Diarrhoea_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_Diarrhoea,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Diarrhoea",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.21, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_Diarrhoea_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/DiarrhoeaSensitivityAnaemiaDiarrhoea_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_Diarrhoea, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/corr_df_Diarrhoea.xlsx")
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_Diarrhoea %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )



##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Lipid module",
    title = "Diarrhoea sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/concordance_diarrhoea_plot.pdf", 
       height = 7.5, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r}
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "TB",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
```

###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_TB %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Lipid module",
    title = "TB sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/concordance_TB_plot.pdf", 
       height = 7.5, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r hiv_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize3, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)
MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen$HIV <- factor(MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen$HIV,
                                                          levels = c("HUU", "HEU", "HIV+"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ HIV  + malaria + diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

  group_by(Modules, HIV) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Lipidomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules5_HIV.csv")


original_results <- original_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(HIV == "HIV+")


HIVSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia <- HIVSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia %>%
  dplyr::filter(HIV == "HIV+")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  HIVSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia


# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_HIV <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_HIV$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_HIV$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_HIV_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_HIV,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "HIV",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.22, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Lipidomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules5_sepsis.csv")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  SepsisensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_SIRS <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_SIRS$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_SIRS$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_SIRS_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_SIRS,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Sepsis",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.25, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_SIRS_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/SepsisSensitivityAnaemiaSIRS_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_df_SIRS, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/corr_df_Sepsis.xlsx")


```


###### Concordance plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_df_SIRS %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Lipid module",
    title = "Sepsis sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/concordance_sepsis_plot.pdf", 
       height = 7.5, width  = 5.5)
```

```{r}
# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Lipid module",
    title = "SIRS sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

```{r anemia_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize3, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)

MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen$anemia <- factor(MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen$anemia,
                                                          levels = c("anemiaNone", "anemiaMild", 
                                                                     "anemiaModerate", "anemiaSevere"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ anemia  + malaria + diarrhoea +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".anemiaanemiaMild|.anemiaanemiaModerate|.anemiaanemiaSevere",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Anaemia"))

Coefficient_etimate_clean$Anaemia <- gsub("anemiaanemia", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Anaemia)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules, Anaemia) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
                                                   "Yes", "No")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(significance_both = ifelse(sum(Anaemia == "anemiaMild" & significance == "Yes", 
                                        na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &
                                      sum(Anaemia == "anemiaModerate" & significance == "Yes", 
                                          na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &
                                      sum(Anaemia == "anemiaSevere" & significance == "Yes", 
                                          na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                    "Common", "Not Common")) %>%
  ungroup()



Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(color_both = ifelse(sum(Anaemia == "anemiaMild" & significance == "Yes", 
                                        na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &
                                      sum(Anaemia == "anemiaModerate" & significance == "Yes", 
                                          na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &
                                      sum(Anaemia == "anemiaSevere" & significance == "Yes", 
                                          na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ,
                                    "darkgreen", "grey30")) %>%
  ungroup()



############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)
```

##### Coeficient Correlation Plot

######## Mild Anaemia

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <-  read_csv("../Data/Processed/Lipidomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules5_anaemia.csv")


original_results <- original_results %>% dplyr::filter(Anaemia == "Mild")

MildAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea <- AnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea %>%
  dplyr::filter(Anaemia == "Mild")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  MildAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoea

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_MildAnaemia_df <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_MildAnaemia_df$Estimate_original,
  corr_MildAnaemia_df$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_MildAnaemia_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_MildAnaemia_df,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Mild Anaemia",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.22, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_MildAnaemia_plot


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/MildAnaemiaSensitivityMalariaDiarr_corr.pdf", height = 5, width  = 5)

writexl::write_xlsx(corr_MildAnaemia_df, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/corr_df_MildAnaemia.xlsx")
```

##### Concordance plot

######## Mild Anaemia

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare module-level significance and concordance
concordance_df <- corr_MildAnaemia_df %>%
  mutate(
    Original_significant = FDR_original < 0.05,
    Sensitivity_significant = FDR_adjusted < 0.05,
    Concordant = Original_significant == Sensitivity_significant
  )

# Original and sensitivity model columns
model_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Original_significant,
    Sensitivity_significant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_significant,
      Sensitivity_significant
    ),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

MildAnaemiaConcordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Lipid module",
    title = "Mild Anaemia sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

##### Pneumonia + Malaria + Diarrhoea + Anaemia

```{r pneumonia_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.6, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)

MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen$pneumonia <- factor(MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen$pneumonia,
                                                          levels = c("pneumoniaNo", "pneumoniaYes"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ pneumonia  + malaria + diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".pneumoniapneumoniaYes",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Pneumonia"))


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
                                                   "Yes", "No")



############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)


Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules5_pneumonia <- Coefficient_etimate_clean


write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules5_pneumonia, "../Data/Processed/Lipidomics/multiWGCNA/Sensitivity/pnuemonia_sensitivity.csv")
```

###### Coeficient Correlation Plot

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Read original model results
original_results <-  read_csv("../Data/Processed/Lipidomics/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules5_pneumonia.csv")

# Sensitivity model results
adjusted_results <-  PneumoniaSensitivityMalariaDiarrhoeaAnaemia

# Merge the original and sensitivity analyses
corr_df_pneumonia <- original_results %>%
  select(
    Modules,
    Estimate_original = Estimate,
    FDR_original = adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    adjusted_results %>%
      select(
        Modules,
        Estimate_adjusted = Estimate,
        FDR_adjusted = adjusted_p.value
      ),
    by = "Modules"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant in both",
      FDR_original < 0.05 & FDR_adjusted >= 0.05 ~ "Primary only",
      FDR_original >= 0.05 & FDR_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Sensitivity only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "Neither",
        "Primary only",
        "Sensitivity only",
        "Significant in both"
      )
    ),
    Discordant_label = if_else(
      Group %in% c("Primary only", "Sensitivity only"),
      Modules,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Pearson correlation
r <- cor(
  corr_df_pneumonia$Estimate_original,
  corr_df_pneumonia$Estimate_adjusted,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Plot
corr_pneumonia_plot <- ggplot(
  corr_df_pneumonia,
  aes(
    x = Estimate_original,
    y = Estimate_adjusted,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Discordant_label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    colour = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neither" = "grey",
      "Primary only" = "purple",
      "Sensitivity only" = "blue",
      "Significant in both" = "red4"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1.4,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r, 3)),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary model coefficient",
    y = "Sensitivity model coefficient",
    title = "Pneumonia",
    colour = "Significance summary"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.2, 0.70),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

corr_pneumonia_plot
```

```{r}
    Model = recode(
      Model,
      Original_significant = "Primary",
      Sensitivity_significant = "Sensitivity"
    ),
    Display_status = if_else(
      Status,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Concordance column
concordance_tiles <- concordance_df %>%
  transmute(
    Modules,
    Model = "Concordance",
    Status = Concordant,
    Display_status = if_else(
      Concordant,
      "Concordant",
      "Discordant"
    )
  )

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  model_tiles,
  concordance_tiles
)

# Order modules numerically
module_order <- concordance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Module_number = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Modules))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module_number) %>%
  pull(Modules)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Modules = factor(
      Modules,
      levels = rev(module_order)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = c(
        "Primary",
        "Sensitivity",
        "Concordance"
      )
    ),
    Display_status = factor(
      Display_status,
      levels = c(
        "Not significant",
        "Significant",
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant"
      )
    )
  )


##########################################################################################

concordance_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Modules
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Display_status,
      colour = Display_status
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = 1,
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Concordant" = 3,
      "Discordant" = 4
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey60",
      "Significant" = "black",
      "Concordant" = "darkgreen",
      "Discordant" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Lipids module",
    title = "Pneumonia sensitivity analysis",
    subtitle = "Concordance of statistical significance between models",
    shape = "", # Classification
    colour = "" # Classification
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 360,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

concordance_plot

ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Proteomics/No_MUAC_Adjustment/AdmissionPoint/Sensitivity/lipodimcs/concordance_pneumonia_plot.pdf", height = 7.5, width  = 5.5)
```

### Interaction model

```{r}

malaria_anaemia_df <- read_csv("../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Sensitivity/malaria_anema_combination.csv")


malaria_anaemia_df <- malaria_anaemia_df %>% dplyr::mutate(
    Malaria_Anaemia = case_when(
      Malaria == 1 & `Mild Anaemia` == 1 ~ "Mal + Mild",
      Malaria == 1 & `Moderate Anaemia` == 1 ~ "Mal + Moderate",
      Malaria == 1 & `Severe Anaemia` == 1 ~ "Mal + Severe",
      Malaria == 1 ~ "Mal only",
      Malaria == 0 & `Mild Anaemia` == 1 ~ "NoMal + Mild",
      Malaria == 0 & `Moderate Anaemia` == 1 ~ "NoMal + Moderate",
      Malaria == 0 & `Severe Anaemia` == 1 ~ "NoMal + Severe",
      TRUE ~ "NoMal + NoAnaemia"
    )
  )


malaria_anaemia_df <- malaria_anaemia_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Malaria_Anaemia = factor(
      Malaria_Anaemia,
      levels = c(
        "NoMal + NoAnaemia",
        "NoMal + Mild",
        "NoMal + Moderate",
        "NoMal + Severe",
        "Mal only",
        "Mal + Mild",
        "Mal + Moderate",
        "Mal + Severe"
      )
    )
  )



malaria_anaemia_df <- malaria_anaemia_df %>%
  mutate(
    AnaemiaSeverity = case_when(
      `Mild Anaemia` == 1 ~ "Mild",
      `Moderate Anaemia` == 1 ~ "Moderate",
      `Severe Anaemia` == 1 ~ "Severe",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    ),
    AnaemiaSeverity = factor(
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      levels = c("None", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe") # ,ordered = TRUE
    )
  )




malaria_anaemia_df <- malaria_anaemia_df %>% dplyr::select(record_id, AnaemiaSeverity)

MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen$record_id <- as.numeric(
MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen$record_id)

malaria_anaemia_df <- malaria_anaemia_df %>% dplyr::left_join(., MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen, join_by(record_id))


MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen <- malaria_anaemia_df

ModuleEigen_df <- MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("LM"))

Adjustedmod_summaries_interaction <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries_interaction[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ malaria*AnaemiaSeverity + # diarrhoea + anemia +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                 weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize5_LipidsModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries_interaction[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% dplyr::filter(str_detect(Modules, "\\.malariamalPositive$"))

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Malaria"))


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
                                                   "Yes", "No")


############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)


malaria_anaemia_interac_lipids <- Coefficient_etimate_clean



write_csv(malaria_anaemia_interac_lipids, "../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Sensitivity/sensitivity_malaria_anaemia_interac_lipids.csv")
```

```{r message = FALSE}
    lr <- anova(.x, .y)

    tibble(
      Chisq = lr$Chisq[2],
      Df = lr$`Chi Df`[2],
      Pvalue = lr$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    )
  },
  .id = "Module"
)
```

```{r}
    Modules = factor(Modules, levels = Modules)
  )


format_fdr <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("NA")
  }

  if (p < 0.001) {
    return(formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
  }

  formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
}


make_module_plot <- function(module_name,
                             module_column,
                             adjusted_p,
                             data) {

  # Extract data for the current module
  module_data <- data %>%
    transmute(
      malaria_recoded,
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      module_value = .data[[module_column]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(module_value),
      !is.na(malaria_recoded),
      !is.na(AnaemiaSeverity)
    )

  # Participant numbers for each malaria–anaemia group
  count_data <- module_data %>%
    count(
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      malaria_recoded,
      name = "n"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      AnaemiaSeverity,
      malaria_recoded,
      fill = list(n = 0)
    )

  # Calculate positions for participant-count labels
  y_min <- min(module_data$module_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(module_data$module_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

  if (!is.finite(y_range) || y_range == 0) {
    y_range <- 1
  }

  count_data <- count_data %>%
    mutate(
      y_position = y_min - 0.10 * y_range,
      n_label = paste0("n=", n)
    )

  ggplot(
    module_data,
    aes(
      x = malaria_recoded,
      y = module_value,
      fill = AnaemiaSeverity
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.65,
      linewidth = 0.35,
      outlier.size = 0.8,
      outlier.alpha = 0.65,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = count_data,
      aes(
        x = malaria_recoded,
        y = y_position,
        label = n_label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.8,
      vjust = 1
    ) +

    facet_grid(
      cols = vars(AnaemiaSeverity),
      scales = "fixed",
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "None" = "lightgreen",
        "Mild" = "lightyellow",
        "Moderate" = "pink",
        "Severe" = "red4"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.22, 0.08))
    ) +

    labs(
      title = module_name,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Interaction FDR = ",
        format_fdr(adjusted_p)
      ),
      x = "Malaria",
      y = module_name,
      fill = NULL
    ) +

    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 12,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 2)
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "plain",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 5)
      ),

      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 8)
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "plain"
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 8,
        face = "plain"
      ),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.075, "cm"),

      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "plain",
        colour = "black"
      ),

      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey85",
        colour = "grey40",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.25,
        colour = "grey92"
      ),

      panel.spacing.x = unit(0.08, "cm"),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 5,
        r = 5,
        b = 5,
        l = 5
      )
    )
}


module_plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(plot_modules)), function(i){

  make_module_plot(
```


## RUN UNIVARIATE ANALYSIS

```{r}

############################################################
# 4. RUN MODELS FOR ALL PROTEINS AND ALL SYNDROMES
############################################################

all_syndrome_results <- list()
failed_models <- list()

for (current_syndrome in names(syndrome_levels)) {

  message("Running syndrome: ", current_syndrome)

  ##########################################################
  # FIT MODELS
  ##########################################################

  model_list <- list()
  failed_proteins <- character(0)

  for (protein in protein_columns) {

    model_formula <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        "`", protein, "` ~ ",
        current_syndrome,
        " + sex_adm + age_adm + (1|site)"
      )
    )

    fit <- tryCatch(
      lmerTest::lmer(
        formula = model_formula,
        weights = weights,
        data = proteomics_data,
        REML = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit)) {

      failed_proteins <- c(failed_proteins, protein)

    } else {

      model_list[[protein]] <- fit

    }

  }

  ##########################################################
  # EXTRACT COEFFICIENTS
  ##########################################################

  coef_list <- list()

  for (protein in names(model_list)) {

    coef_df <-
      lmerTest:::get_coefmat(model_list[[protein]]) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

    coef_df$Protein <- protein

    coef_list[[protein]] <- coef_df

  }

  coef_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_list)

  ##########################################################
  # KEEP ONLY SYNDROME COEFFICIENTS
  ##########################################################

  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      grepl(
        paste0("^", current_syndrome),
        term
      )
    )

  if (nrow(coef_df) == 0) {

    warning(
      paste(
        "No coefficients extracted for",
        current_syndrome
      )
    )

    next

  }

  ##########################################################
  # CREATE COMPARISON LABEL
  ##########################################################

  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      Syndrome = current_syndrome,

      Comparison = gsub(
        paste0("^", current_syndrome),
        "",
        term
      ),

      Reference = syndrome_levels[[current_syndrome]][1],

      Lower = Estimate -
        1.96 * `Std. Error`,

      Upper = Estimate +
        1.96 * `Std. Error`

    )

  ##########################################################
  # ADJUST P VALUES
  ##########################################################

  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Comparison) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      adjusted_p.value =
        p.adjust(
          `Pr(>|t|)`,
          method = "BH"
        ),

      minus_log10_FDR =
        -log10(
          pmax(
            adjusted_p.value,
            .Machine$double.xmin
          )
        ),

      significance =
        dplyr::case_when(

          adjusted_p.value < 0.05 &
            Estimate > 0 ~ "Positive",

          adjusted_p.value < 0.05 &
            Estimate < 0 ~ "Negative",

          TRUE ~ "Not significant"

        )

    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  ##########################################################
  # STORE RESULTS
  ##########################################################

  all_syndrome_results[[current_syndrome]] <- coef_df

  failed_models[[current_syndrome]] <- failed_proteins

}

############################################################
# COMBINE ALL RESULTS
############################################################

all_univariate_proteomics_results <-
  dplyr::bind_rows(all_syndrome_results)

```

# Volcano plot function

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

make_volcano <- function(data,
                         syndrome_name,
                         comparison_name,
                         label_n = 15){

  plot_df <- data %>%
    filter(
      Syndrome == syndrome_name,
      Comparison == comparison_name
    )

  ## proteins to label
  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(adjusted_p.value < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(adjusted_p.value) %>%
    slice_head(n = label_n)

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = Estimate,
      y = minus_log10_FDR
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(colour = significance),
      alpha = 0.75,
      size = 0.5
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = 2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = 2
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = Protein),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        Positive = "#B2182B",
        Negative = "#2166AC",
        `Not significant` = "grey80"
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste(
        syndrome_name,
        ":",
        comparison_name
      ),
      subtitle = paste(
        sum(plot_df$adjusted_p.value < 0.05),
        "significant proteins"
      ),
      x = "Regression coefficient",
      y = expression(-log[10](FDR))
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

}

```

## Heatmap


```{r}


############################################################
# HEATMAP OF TOP DIFFERENTIALLY ABUNDANT PROTEINS
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)


heatmap_results <- all_univariate_proteomics_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Plot_comparison = dplyr::case_when(

      Syndrome == "hiv" &
        Comparison == "HEU" ~
        "HEU vs HUU",

      Syndrome == "hiv" &
        Comparison %in% c("HIV", "HIV+", "HIVPositive") ~
        "HIV+ vs HUU",

      grepl(
        "anaemia|anemia",
        Syndrome,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) &
        Comparison == "Mild" ~
        "Mild vs No Anaemia",

      grepl(
        "anaemia|anemia",
        Syndrome,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) &
        Comparison == "Moderate" ~
        "Moderate vs No Anaemia",

      grepl(
        "anaemia|anemia",
        Syndrome,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) &
        Comparison == "Severe" ~
        "Severe vs No Anaemia",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        Comparison,
        " vs ",
        Reference
      )
    )
  )


#  Check the resulting labels:

heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Syndrome,
    Comparison,
    Reference,
    Plot_comparison
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Syndrome,
    Comparison
  )



############################################################
# SELECT TOP UPREGULATED AND DOWNREGULATED PROTEINS
############################################################

top_n_each_direction <- 10 # 30

top_proteins_by_comparison <- heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Estimate),
    !is.na(adjusted_p.value),
    adjusted_p.value < 0.05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Direction = dplyr::if_else(
      Estimate > 0,
      "Upregulated",
      "Downregulated"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Plot_comparison,
    Direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(abs(Estimate)),
    adjusted_p.value,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = top_n_each_direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


top_proteins_by_comparison %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Plot_comparison,
    Direction
  )


selected_proteins <- top_proteins_by_comparison %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Protein
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    Protein
  )

length(selected_proteins)

############################################################
# CREATE REGRESSION-COEFFICIENT MATRIX
############################################################

coefficient_matrix_df <- heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Protein %in% selected_proteins
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Protein,
    Plot_comparison,
    Estimate
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Protein,
    Plot_comparison,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Plot_comparison,
    values_from = Estimate
  )


coefficient_matrix <- coefficient_matrix_df %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(
    var = "Protein"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()


############################################################
# CREATE FDR MATRIX
############################################################

fdr_matrix_df <- heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Protein %in% selected_proteins
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Protein,
    Plot_comparison,
    adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Protein,
    Plot_comparison,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Plot_comparison,
    values_from = adjusted_p.value
  )


fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix_df %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(
    var = "Protein"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()



fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix[
  rownames(coefficient_matrix),
  colnames(coefficient_matrix),
  drop = FALSE
]


desired_column_order <- c(
  "malPositive vs malNegative",
  "diarrhoeaPositive vs diarrhoeaNegative",
  "TBPositive vs TBNegative",
  "HEU vs HUU",
  "HIV+ vs HUU",
  "SIRSPositive vs SIRSNegative",
  "Mild vs No Anaemia",
  "Moderate vs No Anaemia",
  "Severe vs No Anaemia",
  "pneumoniaPositive vs pneumoniaNegative"
)


desired_column_order <- desired_column_order[
  desired_column_order %in% colnames(coefficient_matrix)
]


remaining_columns <- setdiff(
  colnames(coefficient_matrix),
  desired_column_order
)

final_column_order <- c(
  desired_column_order,
  remaining_columns
)



coefficient_matrix <- coefficient_matrix[
  ,
  final_column_order,
  drop = FALSE
]

fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix[
  ,
  final_column_order,
  drop = FALSE
]


effect_limit <- stats::quantile(
  abs(coefficient_matrix),
  probs = 0.98,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

effect_limit


heatmap_colours <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(
    -effect_limit,
    0,
    effect_limit
  ),
```

```{r}
    lwd = 0.3
  ),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(

    title = "Regression\ncoefficient",

    at = c(
      -effect_limit,
      0,
      effect_limit
    ),

    labels = round(
      c(
        -effect_limit,
        0,
        effect_limit
      ),
      2
    )

  ),

  cell_fun = function(
      j,
      i,
      x,
      y,
      width,
      height,
      fill
  ) {

    current_fdr <- fdr_matrix[i, j]

    if (
      !is.na(current_fdr) &&
      current_fdr < 0.05
    ) {

      grid::grid.text(
        "*",
        x = x,
        y = y,
        gp = grid::gpar(
          fontsize = 7,
          fontface = "bold"
        )
      )
    }
  }
)
```

```{r}

############################################################
# UNIVARIATE metabolomics ANALYSIS ACROSS ALL SYNDROMES
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)


############################################################
# 1. DATA
############################################################

metabolomics_data <- dat


############################################################
# 2. DEFINE SYNDROMES AND THEIR LEVELS
############################################################

syndrome_levels <- list(

  malaria = c("malNegative", "malPositive"),

  diarrhoea = c("diarrhoeaNo", "diarrhoeaYes"),

  TB = c("tbNegative", "tbPositive"),

  HIV = c("HUU", "HEU", "HIV+"),  # HIVPositive
  
  SIRS = c("sirsNo", "sirsYes"),
  
  sepsis = c("sepsisNo", "sepsisYes"),
  
  anemia = c("anemiaNone", "anemiaMild", "anemiaModerate", "anemiaSevere"),
  
  pneumonia = c("pneumoniaNo", "pneumoniaYes"))


lapply(
  names(syndrome_levels),
  function(x) {
    table(
      metabolomics_data[[x]],
      useNA = "ifany"
    )
  }
)



for (syndrome in names(syndrome_levels)) {

  metabolomics_data[[syndrome]] <- factor(
    metabolomics_data[[syndrome]],
    levels = syndrome_levels[[syndrome]]
  )
}


############################################################
# 3. DEFINE METADATA AND metabolite COLUMNS
############################################################

metadata_columns <- c(
  "record_id",
  "site",
  "sex_adm",
  "age_adm",
  "weights",
  names(syndrome_levels)
)


metabolomics_data <- metabolomics_data %>% dplyr::select(-muac_adm)

metabolite_columns <- setdiff(
  colnames(metabolomics_data),
  metadata_columns
)

# Keep only numeric metabolite columns


metabolite_columns <- metabolite_columns[
  vapply(
    metabolomics_data[metabolite_columns],
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)
  )
]

length(metabolite_columns)

head(metabolite_columns)



```

## RUN UNIVARIATE ANALYSIS

```{r}

############################################################
# 4. RUN MODELS FOR ALL metaboliteS AND ALL SYNDROMES
############################################################

all_syndrome_results <- list()
failed_models <- list()

for (current_syndrome in names(syndrome_levels)) {

  message("Running syndrome: ", current_syndrome)

  ##########################################################
  # FIT MODELS
  ##########################################################

  model_list <- list()
  failed_metabolites <- character(0)

  for (metabolite in metabolite_columns) {

    model_formula <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        "`", metabolite, "` ~ ",
        current_syndrome,
        " + sex_adm + age_adm + (1|site)"
      )
    )

    fit <- tryCatch(
      lmerTest::lmer(
        formula = model_formula,
        weights = weights,
        data = metabolomics_data,
        REML = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit)) {

      failed_metabolites <- c(failed_metabolites, metabolite)

    } else {

      model_list[[metabolite]] <- fit

    }

  }

  ##########################################################
  # EXTRACT COEFFICIENTS
  ##########################################################

  coef_list <- list()

  for (metabolite in names(model_list)) {

    coef_df <-
      lmerTest:::get_coefmat(model_list[[metabolite]]) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

    coef_df$metabolite <- metabolite

    coef_list[[metabolite]] <- coef_df

  }

  coef_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_list)

  ##########################################################
  # KEEP ONLY SYNDROME COEFFICIENTS
  ##########################################################

  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      grepl(
        paste0("^", current_syndrome),
        term
      )
    )

  if (nrow(coef_df) == 0) {

    warning(
      paste(
        "No coefficients extracted for",
        current_syndrome
      )
    )

    next

  }

  ##########################################################
  # CREATE COMPARISON LABEL
  ##########################################################

  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      Syndrome = current_syndrome,

      Comparison = gsub(
        paste0("^", current_syndrome),
        "",
        term
      ),

      Reference = syndrome_levels[[current_syndrome]][1],

      Lower = Estimate -
        1.96 * `Std. Error`,

      Upper = Estimate +
        1.96 * `Std. Error`

    )

  ##########################################################
  # ADJUST P VALUES
  ##########################################################

  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Comparison) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      adjusted_p.value =
        p.adjust(
          `Pr(>|t|)`,
          method = "BH"
        ),

      minus_log10_FDR =
        -log10(
          pmax(
            adjusted_p.value,
            .Machine$double.xmin
          )
        ),

      significance =
        dplyr::case_when(

          adjusted_p.value < 0.05 &
            Estimate > 0 ~ "Positive",

          adjusted_p.value < 0.05 &
            Estimate < 0 ~ "Negative",

          TRUE ~ "Not significant"

        )

    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  ##########################################################
  # STORE RESULTS
  ##########################################################

  all_syndrome_results[[current_syndrome]] <- coef_df

  failed_models[[current_syndrome]] <- failed_metabolites

}

############################################################
# COMBINE ALL RESULTS
############################################################

all_univariate_metabolomics_results <-
  dplyr::bind_rows(all_syndrome_results)

```

# Volcano plot function

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

make_volcano <- function(data,
                         syndrome_name,
                         comparison_name,
                         label_n = 15){

  plot_df <- data %>%
    filter(
      Syndrome == syndrome_name,
      Comparison == comparison_name
    )

  ## metabolites to label
  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(adjusted_p.value < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(adjusted_p.value) %>%
    slice_head(n = label_n)

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = Estimate,
      y = minus_log10_FDR
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(colour = significance),
      alpha = 0.75,
      size = 0.5
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = 2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = 2
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = metabolite),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        Positive = "#B2182B",
        Negative = "#2166AC",
        `Not significant` = "grey80"
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste(
        syndrome_name,
        ":",
        comparison_name
      ),
      subtitle = paste(
        sum(plot_df$adjusted_p.value < 0.05),
        "significant metabolites"
      ),
      x = "Regression coefficient",
      y = expression(-log[10](FDR))
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

}

```

## Heatmap


```{r}


############################################################
# HEATMAP OF TOP DIFFERENTIALLY ABUNDANT metaboliteS
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

all_univariate_metabolomics_results <- read_csv("../Figures/UnivariateAnalsyis/Results/Metabolitics/Univariate_metabolomics_results_all_syndromes.csv")

heatmap_results <- all_univariate_metabolomics_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Plot_comparison = dplyr::case_when(

      Syndrome == "hiv" &
        Comparison == "HEU" ~
        "HEU vs HUU",

      Syndrome == "hiv" &
        Comparison %in% c("HIV", "HIV+", "HIVPositive") ~
        "HIV+ vs HUU",

      grepl(
        "anaemia|anemia",
        Syndrome,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) &
        Comparison == "Mild" ~
        "Mild vs No Anaemia",

      grepl(
        "anaemia|anemia",
        Syndrome,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) &
        Comparison == "Moderate" ~
        "Moderate vs No Anaemia",

      grepl(
        "anaemia|anemia",
        Syndrome,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) &
        Comparison == "Severe" ~
        "Severe vs No Anaemia",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        Comparison,
        " vs ",
        Reference
      )
    )
  )


#  Check the resulting labels:

heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Syndrome,
    Comparison,
    Reference,
    Plot_comparison
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Syndrome,
    Comparison
  )



############################################################
# SELECT TOP UPREGULATED AND DOWNREGULATED metaboliteS
############################################################

top_n_each_direction <- 10 # 30

top_metabolites_by_comparison <- heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Estimate),
    !is.na(adjusted_p.value),
    adjusted_p.value < 0.05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Direction = dplyr::if_else(
      Estimate > 0,
      "Upregulated",
      "Downregulated"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Plot_comparison,
    Direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(abs(Estimate)),
    adjusted_p.value,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = top_n_each_direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


top_metabolites_by_comparison %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Plot_comparison,
    Direction
  )


selected_metabolites <- top_metabolites_by_comparison %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    metabolite
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    metabolite
  )

length(selected_metabolites)

############################################################
# CREATE REGRESSION-COEFFICIENT MATRIX
############################################################

coefficient_matrix_df <- heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metabolite %in% selected_metabolites
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    metabolite,
    Plot_comparison,
    Estimate
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    metabolite,
    Plot_comparison,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Plot_comparison,
    values_from = Estimate
  )


coefficient_matrix <- coefficient_matrix_df %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(
    var = "metabolite"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()


############################################################
# CREATE FDR MATRIX
############################################################

fdr_matrix_df <- heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metabolite %in% selected_metabolites
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    metabolite,
    Plot_comparison,
    adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    metabolite,
    Plot_comparison,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Plot_comparison,
    values_from = adjusted_p.value
  )


fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix_df %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(
    var = "metabolite"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()



fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix[
  rownames(coefficient_matrix),
  colnames(coefficient_matrix),
  drop = FALSE
]


desired_column_order <- c(
  "malPositive vs malNegative",
  "diarrhoeaPositive vs diarrhoeaNegative",
  "TBPositive vs TBNegative",
  "HEU vs HUU",
  "HIV+ vs HUU",
  "SIRSPositive vs SIRSNegative",
  "Mild vs No Anaemia",
  "Moderate vs No Anaemia",
  "Severe vs No Anaemia",
  "pneumoniaPositive vs pneumoniaNegative"
)


desired_column_order <- desired_column_order[
  desired_column_order %in% colnames(coefficient_matrix)
]


remaining_columns <- setdiff(
  colnames(coefficient_matrix),
  desired_column_order
)

final_column_order <- c(
  desired_column_order,
  remaining_columns
)



coefficient_matrix <- coefficient_matrix[
  ,
  final_column_order,
  drop = FALSE
]

fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix[
  ,
  final_column_order,
  drop = FALSE
]


effect_limit <- stats::quantile(
  abs(coefficient_matrix),
  probs = 0.98,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

effect_limit


heatmap_colours <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(
    -effect_limit,
    0,
    effect_limit
  ),
  c(
    "#2166AC",
    "white",
    "#B2182B"
  )
)





```


```{r}


############################################################
# GENERATE HEATMAP
############################################################

metabolite_heatmap <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(

  coefficient_matrix,

  name = "Regression\ncoefficient",

  col = heatmap_colours,

  na_col = "grey90",

  cluster_rows = TRUE,

  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  show_row_names = TRUE,

  show_column_names = TRUE,

  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(
    fontsize = 7
  ),

  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(

  ),

  row_title = paste0(
    "Union of top ",

    " positively and negatively associated metabolites"
  ),

  column_title =
    "Clinical syndrome comparisons",

  rect_gp = grid::gpar(
    col = "white",
    lwd = 0.3
  ),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(

    title = "Regression\ncoefficient",

    at = c(
      -effect_limit,
      0,
      effect_limit
    ),

    labels = round(
      c(
        -effect_limit,
        0,
        effect_limit
      ),

    )

  ),

  cell_fun = function(
      j,

      x,
      y,
      width,
      height,

  ) {

    ) {

      grid::grid.text(
        "*",
        x = x,
        y = y,

          fontsize = 7,
          fontface = "bold"
        )
      )
    }
  }
)
```
