```{r}
# 2. DEFINE SYNDROMES AND THEIR LEVELS
############################################################

syndrome_levels <- list(

  malaria = c("malNegative", "malPositive"),

  diarrhoea = c("diarrhoeaNo", "diarrhoeaYes"),

  TB = c("tbNegative", "tbPositive"),

  HIV = c("HUU", "HEU", "HIV+"),  # HIVPositive
  
  SIRS = c("sirsNo", "sirsYes"),
  
  sepsis = c("sepsisNo", "sepsisYes"),
  
  anemia = c("anemiaNone", "anemiaMild", "anemiaModerate", "anemiaSevere"),
  
  pneumonia = c("pneumoniaNo", "pneumoniaYes"))


lapply(
  names(syndrome_levels),
  function(x) {
    table(
      lipidomics_data[[x]],
      useNA = "ifany"
    )
  }
)



for (syndrome in names(syndrome_levels)) {

  lipidomics_data[[syndrome]] <- factor(
    lipidomics_data[[syndrome]],
    levels = syndrome_levels[[syndrome]]
  )
}


############################################################
# 3. DEFINE METADATA AND lipid COLUMNS
############################################################

metadata_columns <- c(
  "record_id",
  "site",
  "sex_adm",
  "age_adm",
  "weights",
  names(syndrome_levels)
)


lipidomics_data <- lipidomics_data %>% dplyr::select(-muac_adm)

lipid_columns <- setdiff(
  colnames(lipidomics_data),
  metadata_columns
)

# Keep only numeric lipid columns


lipid_columns <- lipid_columns[
  vapply(
    lipidomics_data[lipid_columns],
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)
  )
]

length(lipid_columns)

head(lipid_columns)



```

## RUN UNIVARIATE ANALYSIS

```{r}

############################################################
# 4. RUN MODELS FOR ALL lipidS AND ALL SYNDROMES
############################################################

all_syndrome_results <- list()
failed_models <- list()

for (current_syndrome in names(syndrome_levels)) {

  message("Running syndrome: ", current_syndrome)

  ##########################################################
  # FIT MODELS
  ##########################################################

  model_list <- list()
  failed_lipids <- character(0)

  for (lipid in lipid_columns) {

    model_formula <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        "`", lipid, "` ~ ",
        current_syndrome,
        " + sex_adm + age_adm + (1|site)"
      )
    )

    fit <- tryCatch(
      lmerTest::lmer(
        formula = model_formula,
        weights = weights,
        data = lipidomics_data,
        REML = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit)) {

      failed_lipids <- c(failed_lipids, lipid)

    } else {

      model_list[[lipid]] <- fit

    }

  }

  ##########################################################
  # EXTRACT COEFFICIENTS
  ##########################################################

  coef_list <- list()

  for (lipid in names(model_list)) {

    coef_df <-
      lmerTest:::get_coefmat(model_list[[lipid]]) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

    coef_df$lipid <- lipid

    coef_list[[lipid]] <- coef_df

  }

  coef_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_list)

  ##########################################################
  # KEEP ONLY SYNDROME COEFFICIENTS
  ##########################################################

  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      grepl(
        paste0("^", current_syndrome),
        term
      )
    )

  if (nrow(coef_df) == 0) {

    warning(
      paste(
        "No coefficients extracted for",
        current_syndrome
      )
    )

    next

  }

  ##########################################################
  # CREATE COMPARISON LABEL
  ##########################################################

  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      Syndrome = current_syndrome,

      Comparison = gsub(
        paste0("^", current_syndrome),
        "",
        term
      ),

      Reference = syndrome_levels[[current_syndrome]][1],

      Lower = Estimate -
        1.96 * `Std. Error`,

      Upper = Estimate +
        1.96 * `Std. Error`

    )

  ##########################################################
  # ADJUST P VALUES
  ##########################################################

  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Comparison) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      adjusted_p.value =
        p.adjust(
          `Pr(>|t|)`,
          method = "BH"
        ),

      minus_log10_FDR =
        -log10(
          pmax(
            adjusted_p.value,
            .Machine$double.xmin
          )
        ),

      significance =
        dplyr::case_when(

          adjusted_p.value < 0.05 &
            Estimate > 0 ~ "Positive",

          adjusted_p.value < 0.05 &
            Estimate < 0 ~ "Negative",

          TRUE ~ "Not significant"

        )

    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  ##########################################################
  # STORE RESULTS
  ##########################################################

  all_syndrome_results[[current_syndrome]] <- coef_df

  failed_models[[current_syndrome]] <- failed_lipids

}

############################################################
# COMBINE ALL RESULTS
############################################################

all_univariate_lipidomics_results <-
  dplyr::bind_rows(all_syndrome_results)

```

# Volcano plot function

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

make_volcano <- function(data,
                         syndrome_name,
                         comparison_name,
                         label_n = 15){

  plot_df <- data %>%
    filter(
      Syndrome == syndrome_name,
      Comparison == comparison_name
    )

  ## lipids to label
  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(adjusted_p.value < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(adjusted_p.value) %>%
    slice_head(n = label_n)

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = Estimate,
      y = minus_log10_FDR
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(colour = significance),
      alpha = 0.75,
      size = 0.5
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = 2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = 2
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = lipid),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        Positive = "#B2182B",
        Negative = "#2166AC",
        `Not significant` = "grey80"
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste(
        syndrome_name,
        ":",
        comparison_name
      ),
      subtitle = paste(
        sum(plot_df$adjusted_p.value < 0.05),
        "significant lipids"
      ),
      x = "Regression coefficient",
      y = expression(-log[10](FDR))
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

}

```

## Heatmap


```{r}


############################################################
# HEATMAP OF TOP DIFFERENTIALLY ABUNDANT lipidS
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)


heatmap_results <- all_univariate_lipidomics_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Plot_comparison = dplyr::case_when(

      Syndrome == "hiv" &
        Comparison == "HEU" ~
        "HEU vs HUU",

      Syndrome == "hiv" &
        Comparison %in% c("HIV", "HIV+", "HIVPositive") ~
        "HIV+ vs HUU",

      grepl(
        "anaemia|anemia",
        Syndrome,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) &
        Comparison == "Mild" ~
        "Mild vs No Anaemia",

      grepl(
        "anaemia|anemia",
        Syndrome,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) &
        Comparison == "Moderate" ~
        "Moderate vs No Anaemia",

      grepl(
        "anaemia|anemia",
        Syndrome,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) &
        Comparison == "Severe" ~
        "Severe vs No Anaemia",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        Comparison,
        " vs ",
        Reference
      )
    )
  )


#  Check the resulting labels:

heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Syndrome,
    Comparison,
    Reference,
    Plot_comparison
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Syndrome,
    Comparison
  )



############################################################
# SELECT TOP UPREGULATED AND DOWNREGULATED lipidS
############################################################

top_n_each_direction <- 10 # 30

top_lipids_by_comparison <- heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Estimate),
    !is.na(adjusted_p.value),
    adjusted_p.value < 0.05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Direction = dplyr::if_else(
      Estimate > 0,
      "Upregulated",
      "Downregulated"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Plot_comparison,
    Direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(abs(Estimate)),
    adjusted_p.value,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = top_n_each_direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


top_lipids_by_comparison %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Plot_comparison,
    Direction
  )


selected_lipids <- top_lipids_by_comparison %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    lipid
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    lipid
  )

length(selected_lipids)

############################################################
# CREATE REGRESSION-COEFFICIENT MATRIX
############################################################

coefficient_matrix_df <- heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    lipid %in% selected_lipids
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    lipid,
    Plot_comparison,
    Estimate
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    lipid,
    Plot_comparison,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Plot_comparison,
    values_from = Estimate
  )


coefficient_matrix <- coefficient_matrix_df %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(
    var = "lipid"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()


############################################################
# CREATE FDR MATRIX
############################################################

fdr_matrix_df <- heatmap_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    lipid %in% selected_lipids
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    lipid,
    Plot_comparison,
    adjusted_p.value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    lipid,
    Plot_comparison,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Plot_comparison,
    values_from = adjusted_p.value
  )


fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix_df %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(
    var = "lipid"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()



fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix[
  rownames(coefficient_matrix),
  colnames(coefficient_matrix),
  drop = FALSE
]


desired_column_order <- c(
  "malPositive vs malNegative",
  "diarrhoeaPositive vs diarrhoeaNegative",
  "TBPositive vs TBNegative",
  "HEU vs HUU",
  "HIV+ vs HUU",
  "SIRSPositive vs SIRSNegative",
  "Mild vs No Anaemia",
  "Moderate vs No Anaemia",
  "Severe vs No Anaemia",
  "pneumoniaPositive vs pneumoniaNegative"
)


desired_column_order <- desired_column_order[
  desired_column_order %in% colnames(coefficient_matrix)
]


remaining_columns <- setdiff(
  colnames(coefficient_matrix),
  desired_column_order
)

final_column_order <- c(
  desired_column_order,
  remaining_columns
)



coefficient_matrix <- coefficient_matrix[
  ,
  final_column_order,
  drop = FALSE
]

fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix[
  ,
  final_column_order,
  drop = FALSE
]


effect_limit <- stats::quantile(
  abs(coefficient_matrix),
  probs = 0.98,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

effect_limit


heatmap_colours <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(
    -effect_limit,
    0,
    effect_limit
  ),
  c(
    "#2166AC",
    "white",
    "#B2182B"
  )
)





```


```{r}


############################################################
# GENERATE HEATMAP
############################################################

lipid_heatmap <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(

  coefficient_matrix,

  name = "Regression\ncoefficient",

  col = heatmap_colours,

  na_col = "grey90",

  cluster_rows = TRUE,

  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  show_row_names = TRUE,

  show_column_names = TRUE,

  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(
    fontsize = 7
  ),

  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(
    fontsize = 9,
    fontface = "bold"
  ),

  column_names_rot = 45,

  row_title = paste0(
    "Union of top ",
    top_n_each_direction,
    " positively and negatively associated lipids"
  ),

  column_title =
    "Clinical syndrome comparisons",

  rect_gp = grid::gpar(
    col = "white",
    lwd = 0.3
  ),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(

    title = "Regression\ncoefficient",

    at = c(
      -effect_limit,
      0,
      effect_limit
    ),

    labels = round(
      c(
        -effect_limit,
        0,
        effect_limit
      ),
      2
    )

  ),

  cell_fun = function(
      j,
      i,
      x,
      y,
      width,
      height,
      fill
  ) {

    current_fdr <- fdr_matrix[i, j]

    if (
      !is.na(current_fdr) &&
      current_fdr < 0.05
    ) {

      grid::grid.text(
        "*",
        x = x,
        y = y,
        gp = grid::gpar(
          fontsize = 7,
          fontface = "bold"
        )
      )
    }
  }
)
```

```{r malaria_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.8, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
proteomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/proteomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity.csv")


MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- proteomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity %>% 
  dplyr::filter(malaria == "malPositive" | is.na(malaria))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria %>% replace_na("CP")
  

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria, 
                                             levels = c("CP", "malPositive"))

ModuleEigen_df <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("PM"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ malaria  + muac_adm +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                # weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".malariamalPositive",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Malaria"))

# Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting <- gsub("wasting", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni fdr

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules # Wasting, 
           ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Create a new column 'significance' based on the conditions
Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")


############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)


Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria <- Coefficient_etimate_clean


# write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria, "../Data/Processed/Proteomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria.csv")


write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/malaria_estimates.csv")


############################################################################################################
# Forest plot with estimates
############################################################################################################


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/malaria_estimates.csv")

cPM_malaria <- 
  Coefficient_etimate_clean  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = fct_reorder(Modules, Estimate), colour = significance)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Estimate), size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                 height = 0.45, linewidth = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
 # xlim(-0.05, 0.05) +
  #geom_linerange(aes(xmin=Lower_bound_C1_2, xmax=Upper_bound_C1_2))   +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed",  linewidth = 0.35 ) +

  theme_light()+
  labs(x="Coefficient estimates (95% CI)", y="Modules",
       color = "BP Signf status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.55),
        legend.position = c(0.95, 0.905),
        text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        legend.title  =  element_text(size=5),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05,"cm"),
        # Change Y-axis label colors based on 'significance_both'
        # axis.text.y = element_markdown(face = "bold",
        #                                color = Coefficient_etimate_clean$color_both),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "grey95")
        ) +
  #ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  # facet_wrap(~ Nutri_status, scales = "free_y")
  #facet_grid(~ Wasting) +
  guides(y.sec=ggh4x::guide_axis_manual(title = element_blank(),
                                        breaks = Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules,
                                        labels = paste0("n=", Coefficient_etimate_clean$size)))



cPM_malaria



```

```{r diarrhoea_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)


proteomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/proteomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity.csv")
```

```{r sirs_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
  dplyr::filter(SIRS == "sirsYes" | is.na(SIRS))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$SIRS <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$SIRS %>% replace_na("CP")
  

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$SIRS <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$SIRS, 
                                             levels = c("CP", "sirsYes"))

ModuleEigen_df <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("PM"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ SIRS  + muac_adm +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                # weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni fdr

  group_by(Modules # Wasting, 
           ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Create a new column 'significance' based on the conditions
Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")


############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)
```

#### Summary of biological Pathways across syndromes 

The code chunk below summaries the association of specific syndromes with biological systems. The dots represent significant association with red color indicating negative associations while green colour represent positive association. 


```{r}

malaria <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/malaria_estimates.csv")

malaria <- malaria %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Malaria)

malaria$Syndromes <- "Malaria"

diarrhoea <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/diarrhoea_estimates.csv")

diarrhoea <- diarrhoea %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Diarrhoea)

diarrhoea$Syndromes <- "Diarrhoea"

TB <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/TB_estimates.csv")

TB <- TB %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = TB)

TB$Syndromes <- "TB"

HIV <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/HIV_estimates.csv")

HIV <- HIV %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = HIV)

HEU <- HIV %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "HIVHEU")

HEU$Syndromes <- "HEU"

HIV <- HIV %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "HIVHEI")

HIV$Syndromes <- "HIV+"

sepsis <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/sepsis_estimates.csv")

sepsis <- sepsis %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Sepsis)

sepsis$Syndromes <- "Sepsis"

sirs <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/sirs_estimates.csv")

sirs <- sirs %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = SIRS)

sirs$Syndromes <- "SIRS"

anaemia <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/anaemia_estimates.csv")

anaemia <- anaemia %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Anemia)


Mild <- anaemia %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "anemiaanemiaMild")

Mild$Syndromes <- "MildAnemia"

Moderate <- anaemia %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "anemiaanemiaModerate")

Moderate$Syndromes <- "ModerateAnemia"

Severe <- anaemia %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "anemiaanemiaSevere")

Severe$Syndromes <- "SevereAnemia"

pneumonia <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/pneumonia_estimates.csv")

pneumonia <- pneumonia %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Pneumonia)

pneumonia$Syndromes <- "Pneumonia"

```



```{r warning=FALSE, syndrome_associations_5, fig.height = 16, fig.width = 8.75}


dot_plot_cp_hosp <- bind_rows(malaria, diarrhoea, TB, HEU, HIV, sirs, sepsis, Mild, Moderate, Severe, pneumonia)

dot_plot_cp_hosp <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Directionality = case_when(
      Estimate > 0 & significance == "Yes" ~ "Increased",
      Estimate < 0 & significance == "Yes" ~ "Decreased",
      TRUE ~ "Non-significant"))



dot_plot_cp_hosp <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  mutate(significance_plot = ifelse(significance == "Yes", 1, NA))  # Replace "Yes" with 1 for plotting dots



dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes <- factor(dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes, 
                                           levels = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS", "Sepsis", 
                                                      "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia",
                                                      "Pneumonia"))


write_csv(dot_plot_cp_hosp, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/dot_plot_cp_hosp.csv")


dot_plot_cp_hosp <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/dot_plot_cp_hosp.csv")


dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes <- factor(dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes, 
                                           levels = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS", "Sepsis", 
                                                      "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia",
                                                      "Pneumonia"))


########################################################################################
# Plotting
##########################################################################################

library(ggthemes)


library(ggthemes)

syndrome_count <- data.frame(Syndromes = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS",
                                           "Sepsis", "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia", "Pneumonia"),
                             Count = c(100, 520, 20, 65, 67, 364, 150, 200, 426, 147, 380))


# Create new labels with line break and count
syndrome_count <- syndrome_count %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste0(Syndromes, "(n=", Count, ")")) # \n

# Create a named vector for x-axis labels
syndrome_label_vector <- setNames(syndrome_count$label, syndrome_count$Syndromes)


# Re-define factor levels ONCE and enforce it permanently
syndrome_levels <- c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS", "Sepsis", 
                     "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia", "Pneumonia")

dot_plot_cp_hosp <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels),
    Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules)  # Clean up module names
  )

# Split data to preserve factor levels in both groups
df_sig <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))

df_nonsig <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))


ggplot(dot_plot_cp_hosp, aes(x = Syndromes, y = Modules)) +
  # Significant points
  geom_point(data = df_sig, aes(size = abs(Estimate), 
                                fill = Directionality, color = Directionality), shape = 21) +
  # Non-significant as dots
  geom_point(data = df_nonsig, shape = ".", color = "black") +

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 6), guide = "legend") + # range = c(2, 5),
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increased" = "lightgreen", "Decreased" = "pink", "Non-significant" = NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "green4", "Decreased" = "red3", "Non-significant" = "black")) +

  labs(x = "Syndromes", y = "Modules", 
       title = "Significant Associations (Colored Bubbles for 'Yes')",
       size = "Estimates", color = "Association", fill = "Association") + # Coefficient

  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical", 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5,  size = 20), # vjust = 0.95,
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26, margin = margin(t = -15)), # 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 26, color = "blue", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20)
  ) +
 scale_x_discrete(labels = syndrome_label_vector, drop = FALSE)


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Proteomics/proteomics_summary_all_sydromes.pdf")


```

```{r}
MetabolitesCommunityPC1s <- MetabolitesCommunityPC1s %>%
  mutate(SampleID = gsub("\\D", "", SampleID))

MetabolitesCommunityPC1s$SampleID <- as.numeric(MetabolitesCommunityPC1s$SampleID)


MetabolitesCommunityPC1s <-  CommunityTable1  %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., MetabolitesCommunityPC1s, join_by(record_id == SampleID ))


colnames(Metabolomics_modules_well_sick) <- gsub("^PM0([0-9]{2})_adm$", "PM\\1", colnames(Metabolomics_modules_well_sick))

Metabolomics_modules_well_sick$group_adm <- "Hospital"

Metabolomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity <- bind_rows(Metabolomics_modules_well_sick, MetabolitesCommunityPC1s)
```

## Malaria vs CP

```{r malaria_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.8, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)

write_csv(Metabolomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/Metabolomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity.csv")

Metabolomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/Metabolomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity.csv")


MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- Metabolomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity %>% 
  dplyr::filter(malaria == "malPositive" | is.na(malaria))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria %>% replace_na("CP")
  

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria, 
                                             levels = c("CP", "malPositive"))

ModuleEigen_df <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("MM"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ malaria  + muac_adm +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                # weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".malariamalPositive",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Malaria"))

# Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting <- gsub("wasting", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni fdr

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules # Wasting, 
           ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Create a new column 'significance' based on the conditions
Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")


############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)


Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria <- Coefficient_etimate_clean


# write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria, "../Data/Processed/Metabolomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria.csv")


write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/malaria_estimates.csv")


############################################################################################################
# Forest plot with estimates
############################################################################################################


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/malaria_estimates.csv")

cPM_malaria <- 
  Coefficient_etimate_clean  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = fct_reorder(Modules, Estimate), colour = significance)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Estimate), size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                 height = 0.45, linewidth = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
 # xlim(-0.05, 0.05) +
  #geom_linerange(aes(xmin=Lower_bound_C1_2, xmax=Upper_bound_C1_2))   +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed",  linewidth = 0.35 ) +

  theme_light()+
  labs(x="Coefficient estimates (95% CI)", y="Modules",
       color = "BP Signf status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.55),
        legend.position = c(0.95, 0.905),
        text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        legend.title  =  element_text(size=5),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05,"cm"),
        # Change Y-axis label colors based on 'significance_both'
        # axis.text.y = element_markdown(face = "bold",
        #                                color = Coefficient_etimate_clean$color_both),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "grey95")
        ) +
  #ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  # facet_wrap(~ Nutri_status, scales = "free_y")
  #facet_grid(~ Wasting) +
  guides(y.sec=ggh4x::guide_axis_manual(title = element_blank(),
                                        breaks = Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules,
                                        labels = paste0("n=", Coefficient_etimate_clean$size)))



cPM_malaria



```

```{r diarrhoea_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni fdr

           ) %>%

    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

#### Summary of biological Pathways across syndromes 

The code chunk below summaries the association of specific syndromes with biological systems. The dots represent significant association with red color indicating negative associations while green colour represent positive association. 


```{r}

malaria <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/malaria_estimates.csv")

malaria <- malaria %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Malaria)

malaria$Syndromes <- "Malaria"

diarrhoea <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/diarrhoea_estimates.csv")

diarrhoea <- diarrhoea %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Diarrhoea)

diarrhoea$Syndromes <- "Diarrhoea"

TB <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/TB_estimates.csv")

TB <- TB %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = TB)

TB$Syndromes <- "TB"

HIV <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/HIV_estimates.csv")

HIV <- HIV %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = HIV)

HEU <- HIV %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "HIVHEU")

HEU$Syndromes <- "HEU"

HIV <- HIV %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "HIVHIV+")

HIV$Syndromes <- "HIV+"

sepsis <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/sepsis_estimates.csv")

sepsis <- sepsis %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Sepsis)

sepsis$Syndromes <- "Sepsis"

sirs <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/sirs_estimates.csv")

sirs <- sirs %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = SIRS)

sirs$Syndromes <- "SIRS"

anaemia <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/anaemia_estimates.csv")

anaemia <- anaemia %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Anemia)


Mild <- anaemia %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "anemiaanemiaMild")

Mild$Syndromes <- "MildAnemia"

Moderate <- anaemia %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "anemiaanemiaModerate")

Moderate$Syndromes <- "ModerateAnemia"

Severe <- anaemia %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "anemiaanemiaSevere")

Severe$Syndromes <- "SevereAnemia"

pneumonia <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/pneumonia_estimates.csv")

pneumonia <- pneumonia %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Pneumonia)

pneumonia$Syndromes <- "Pneumonia"
```

```{r warning=FALSE, syndrome_associations_5, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 8.75}


dot_plot_cp_hosp <- bind_rows(malaria, diarrhoea, TB, HEU, HIV, sirs, sepsis, Mild, Moderate, Severe, pneumonia)

dot_plot_cp_hosp <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Directionality = case_when(
      Estimate > 0 & significance == "Yes" ~ "Increased",
      Estimate < 0 & significance == "Yes" ~ "Decreased",
      TRUE ~ "Non-significant"))



dot_plot_cp_hosp <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  mutate(significance_plot = ifelse(significance == "Yes", 1, NA))  # Replace "Yes" with 1 for plotting dots



dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes <- factor(dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes, 
                                           levels = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS", "Sepsis", 
                                                      "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia",
                                                      "Pneumonia"))


write_csv(dot_plot_cp_hosp, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/dot_plot_cp_hosp.csv")


dot_plot_cp_hosp <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/dot_plot_cp_hosp.csv")


dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes <- factor(dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes, 
                                           levels = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS", "Sepsis", 
                                                      "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia",
                                                      "Pneumonia"))


########################################################################################
# Plotting
##########################################################################################

library(ggthemes)


library(ggthemes)

syndrome_count <- data.frame(Syndromes = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS",
                                           "Sepsis", "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia", "Pneumonia"),
                             Count = c(105, 524, 21, 67, 67, 373, 152, 200, 438, 144, 383))


# Create new labels with line break and count
syndrome_count <- syndrome_count %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste0(Syndromes, "(n=", Count, ")")) # \n

# Create a named vector for x-axis labels
syndrome_label_vector <- setNames(syndrome_count$label, syndrome_count$Syndromes)


# Re-define factor levels ONCE and enforce it permanently
syndrome_levels <- c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS", "Sepsis", 
                     "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia", "Pneumonia")

dot_plot_cp_hosp <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels),
    Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules)  # Clean up module names
  )

# Split data to preserve factor levels in both groups
df_sig <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))

df_nonsig <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))


ggplot(dot_plot_cp_hosp, aes(x = Syndromes, y = Modules)) +
  # Significant points
  geom_point(data = df_sig, aes(size = abs(Estimate), 
                                fill = Directionality, color = Directionality), shape = 21) +
  # Non-significant as dots
  geom_point(data = df_nonsig, shape = ".", color = "black") +

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 6), guide = "legend") + # range = c(2, 5),
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increased" = "lightgreen", "Decreased" = "pink", "Non-significant" = NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "green4", "Decreased" = "red3", "Non-significant" = "black")) +

  labs(x = "Syndromes", y = "Modules", 
       title = "Significant Associations (Colored Bubbles for 'Yes')",
       size = "Estimates", color = "Association", fill = "Association") + # Coefficient

  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical", 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5,  size = 20), # vjust = 0.95,
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26, margin = margin(t = -15)), # 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 26, color = "blue", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20)
  ) +
 scale_x_discrete(labels = syndrome_label_vector, drop = FALSE)


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Metabolomics/Metabolomics_summary_all_sydromes.pdf")
```

## Malaria vs CP

```{r malaria_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.8, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}

library(ggtext)

write_csv(Lipidomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/Lipidomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity.csv")

Lipidomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/Lipidomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity.csv")


MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- Lipidomics_modules_well_sick_sensitivity %>% 
  dplyr::filter(malaria == "malPositive" | is.na(malaria))

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria %>% replace_na("CP")
  

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$malaria, 
                                             levels = c("CP", "malPositive"))

ModuleEigen_df <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("LM"))

Adjustedmod_summaries <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ malaria  + muac_adm +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                # weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl(".malariamalPositive",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Malaria"))

# Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting <- gsub("wasting", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni fdr

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules # Wasting, 
           ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Create a new column 'significance' based on the conditions
Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")


############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)


Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria <- Coefficient_etimate_clean


# write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria, "../Data/Processed/Lipidomics/multiWGCNA/NCC_24Percent/Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria.csv")


write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/malaria_estimates.csv")


############################################################################################################
# Forest plot with estimates
############################################################################################################


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/malaria_estimates.csv")

cPM_malaria <- 
  Coefficient_etimate_clean  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = fct_reorder(Modules, Estimate), colour = significance)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Estimate), size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                 height = 0.45, linewidth = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
 # xlim(-0.05, 0.05) +
  #geom_linerange(aes(xmin=Lower_bound_C1_2, xmax=Upper_bound_C1_2))   +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed",  linewidth = 0.35 ) +

  theme_light()+
  labs(x="Coefficient estimates (95% CI)", y="Modules",
       color = "BP Signf status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.55),
        legend.position = c(0.95, 0.905),
        text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        legend.title  =  element_text(size=5),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05,"cm"),
        # Change Y-axis label colors based on 'significance_both'
        # axis.text.y = element_markdown(face = "bold",
        #                                color = Coefficient_etimate_clean$color_both),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "grey95")
        ) +
  #ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  # facet_wrap(~ Nutri_status, scales = "free_y")
  #facet_grid(~ Wasting) +
  guides(y.sec=ggh4x::guide_axis_manual(title = element_blank(),
                                        breaks = Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules,
                                        labels = paste0("n=", Coefficient_etimate_clean$size)))



cPM_malaria


```

```{r sepse_no_wasting_adj_minModlueSize10, fig.width=3.2, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ sepsis  + muac_adm +
                                                   sex_adm +  age_adm + (1|site),
                                                # weights = weights,
                                                 data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[grepl("sepsisYes",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Sepsis"))

# Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting <- gsub("wasting", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni fdr

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules # Wasting, 
           ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Create a new column 'significance' based on the conditions
Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")


############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)


Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria <- Coefficient_etimate_clean

write_csv(Coefficient_etimate_clean_minModules10_malaria, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/sepsis_estimates.csv")


############################################################################################################
# Forest plot with estimates
############################################################################################################


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/sepsis_estimates.csv")

cPM_sepsis <- 
  Coefficient_etimate_clean  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = fct_reorder(Modules, Estimate), colour = significance)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Estimate), size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                 height = 0.45, linewidth = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
 # xlim(-0.05, 0.05) +
  #geom_linerange(aes(xmin=Lower_bound_C1_2, xmax=Upper_bound_C1_2))   +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed",  linewidth = 0.35 ) +

  theme_light()+
  labs(x="Coefficient estimates (95% CI)", y="Modules",
       color = "BP Signf status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.55),
        legend.position = c(0.95, 0.905),
        text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        legend.title  =  element_text(size=5),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05,"cm"),
        # Change Y-axis label colors based on 'significance_both'
        # axis.text.y = element_markdown(face = "bold",
        #                                color = Coefficient_etimate_clean$color_both),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "grey95")
        ) +
  #ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

#### Summary of biological Pathways across syndromes 

The code chunk below summaries the association of specific syndromes with biological systems. The dots represent significant association with red color indicating negative associations while green colour represent positive association. 


```{r}

malaria <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/malaria_estimates.csv")

malaria <- malaria %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Malaria)

malaria$Syndromes <- "Malaria"

diarrhoea <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/diarrhoea_estimates.csv")

diarrhoea <- diarrhoea %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Diarrhoea)

diarrhoea$Syndromes <- "Diarrhoea"

TB <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/TB_estimates.csv")

TB <- TB %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = TB)

TB$Syndromes <- "TB"

HIV <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/HIV_estimates.csv")

HIV <- HIV %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = HIV)

HEU <- HIV %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "HIVHEU")

HEU$Syndromes <- "HEU"

HIV <- HIV %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "HIVHIV+")

HIV$Syndromes <- "HIV+"

sepsis <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/sepsis_estimates.csv")

sepsis <- sepsis %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Sepsis)

sepsis$Syndromes <- "Sepsis"

sirs <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/sirs_estimates.csv")

sirs <- sirs %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = SIRS)

sirs$Syndromes <- "SIRS"

anaemia <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/anaemia_estimates.csv")

anaemia <- anaemia %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Anemia)


Mild <- anaemia %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "anemiaanemiaMild")

Mild$Syndromes <- "MildAnemia"

Moderate <- anaemia %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "anemiaanemiaModerate")

Moderate$Syndromes <- "ModerateAnemia"

Severe <- anaemia %>% dplyr::filter(Syndrome == "anemiaanemiaSevere")

Severe$Syndromes <- "SevereAnemia"

pneumonia <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/pneumonia_estimates.csv")

pneumonia <- pneumonia %>% dplyr::rename(Syndrome = Pneumonia)

pneumonia$Syndromes <- "Pneumonia"
```

```{r warning=FALSE, syndrome_associations_5, fig.height = 14, fig.width = 8.75}


dot_plot_cp_hosp <- bind_rows(malaria, diarrhoea, TB, HEU, HIV, sirs, sepsis, Mild, Moderate, Severe, pneumonia)

dot_plot_cp_hosp <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Directionality = case_when(
      Estimate > 0 & significance == "Yes" ~ "Increased",
      Estimate < 0 & significance == "Yes" ~ "Decreased",
      TRUE ~ "Non-significant"))



dot_plot_cp_hosp <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  mutate(significance_plot = ifelse(significance == "Yes", 1, NA))  # Replace "Yes" with 1 for plotting dots



dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes <- factor(dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes, 
                                           levels = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS", "Sepsis", 
                                                      "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia",
                                                      "Pneumonia"))


write_csv(dot_plot_cp_hosp, "../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/dot_plot_cp_hosp.csv")


dot_plot_cp_hosp <- read_csv("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/dot_plot_cp_hosp.csv")


dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes <- factor(dot_plot_cp_hosp$Syndromes, 
                                           levels = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS", "Sepsis", 
                                                      "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia",
                                                      "Pneumonia"))


########################################################################################
# Plotting
##########################################################################################

library(ggthemes)


library(ggthemes)

syndrome_count <- data.frame(Syndromes = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS",
                                           "Sepsis", "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia", "Pneumonia"),
                             Count = c(96, 490, 16, 56, 58, 339, 135, 185, 401, 139, 353))


# Create new labels with line break and count
syndrome_count <- syndrome_count %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste0(Syndromes, "(n=", Count, ")")) # \n

# Create a named vector for x-axis labels
syndrome_label_vector <- setNames(syndrome_count$label, syndrome_count$Syndromes)


# Re-define factor levels ONCE and enforce it permanently
syndrome_levels <- c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "SIRS", "Sepsis", 
                     "MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnemia", "Pneumonia")

dot_plot_cp_hosp <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels),
    Modules = gsub("_adm$", "", Modules)  # Clean up module names
  )

# Split data to preserve factor levels in both groups
df_sig <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))

df_nonsig <- dot_plot_cp_hosp %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))


ggplot(dot_plot_cp_hosp, aes(x = Syndromes, y = Modules)) +
  # Significant points
  geom_point(data = df_sig, aes(size = abs(Estimate), 
                                fill = Directionality, color = Directionality), shape = 21) +
  # Non-significant as dots
  geom_point(data = df_nonsig, shape = ".", color = "black") +

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 6), guide = "legend") + # range = c(2, 5),
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increased" = "lightgreen", "Decreased" = "pink", "Non-significant" = NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "green4", "Decreased" = "red3", "Non-significant" = "black")) +

  labs(x = "Syndromes", y = "Modules", 
       title = "Significant Associations (Colored Bubbles for 'Yes')",
       size = "Estimates", color = "Association", fill = "Association") + # Coefficient

  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical", 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5,  size = 20), # vjust = 0.95,
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26, margin = margin(t = -15)), # 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 26, color = "blue", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20)
  ) +
 scale_x_discrete(labels = syndrome_label_vector, drop = FALSE)


ggsave("../Figures/ForestPlots/Community/Lipidomics/Lipidomics_summary_all_sydromes.pdf")
```
